versions.changelog: English only, removed agent names, cleaner cron setup

Initial release of trash-manager:

- Provides a unified trash system with index tracking for all agents.
- Enforces deletion via trash-manager.sh add, disallowing direct rm/mv to trash.
- Maintains index.json with original path, trashed location, timestamp, and filename.
- Supports auto-cleanup of files older than 7 days (via cron).
- Includes commands for add, clean (with --dry-run), list, and restore.
- Ensures all agents share the same trash and index for consistent file management.
